episodes.title: What Happens to a $1,000 Upwork Invoice After Platform, Payoneer FX & 1% Gross Turnover Tax?
episodes.target_audience_question: How much of a $1,000 Upwork contract actually reaches an Armenian or Georgian bank account after platform fees, FX spread, and gross turnover tax, and what gross invoice is required to net $1,000?
episodes.caption_with_link:
Why a $1,000 freelance contract turns into ~$862.04 after multi-stage deductions & gross turnover tax:

1. Marketplace fee (10% example + $0.99): -$100.99 ($899.01 transferred)
2. Payout rail + ~2% FX conversion spread: -$26.97 ($872.04 received)
3. 1% turnover tax on $1,000.00 FULL GROSS invoice (RA Tax Code Art. 257): -$10.00
= $862.04 Net Take-Home (or invoice $1,159.86 to net $1,000.00).

Note: The 1% high-tech rate and 0% micro-business regime apply strictly to qualifying activities and eligible taxpayers (standard turnover tax is 5%). Educational mathematical estimate only, not tax advice.

episodes.title: Why Adding 10% to a $1,000 Invoice Does NOT Net $1,000 (Reverse Gross-Up Formula)
episodes.target_audience_question: How do I calculate the exact invoice amount to charge a client so I receive my exact target net payout after fees?
episodes.caption_with_link:
Adding +10% to a $1,000 invoice nets $990, not $1,000.

Exact Reverse Gross-Up Formula:
Required Gross = (Target Net + Fixed Fee) / (1 - Total Fee %)
For $1,000 net at 10% + $0.99 withdrawal: ($1,000 + $0.99) / 0.90 = $1,112.21.
